data.title: bn-2ee4c: Ed25519 signing identities (ADR-0054) in continuum-evidence

data.body: [severity:high] Unknown signer standing fails open as Active. check maps a signer absent from this registry to VerifiedStanding::Active. An authentic signature from an allowed but revoked key therefore verifies whenever this verifier lacks the revocation record. ADR-0054 lines 159-160 and 202-203 state that revocation distribution is absent, so this is reachable by construction. Treat missing standing or missing freshness as typed unverified or inconclusive, or require an authoritative registry entry before Verified.

[severity:high] TEST-9-07 is marked delivered without a production execution path. This range adds no runtime caller of SigningRegistry or SignatureVerifier outside this module and its tests. ADR-0054 lines 149-158 explicitly defer daemon, wire, intent.accept, and producer integration. The tests sign synthetic ContentIdentity values, so real receipts, intent bundles, and domain packs remain unsigned and unverified. Keep TEST-9-07 active or partial, and keep the T04 signing control typed as a gap, until end-to-end paths exist.

[severity:medium] The raw 32-byte secret seed is not zeroized. mint stores it in a normal stack array, and LocalSigner::from_seed passes it by reference. ed25519-dalek copies it into its zeroizing SigningKey, but the original array drops without a wipe. This contradicts the key-custody claim. Take the seed by value and zeroize it on every success and error path.

[severity:medium] Untrusted signature text is fully decoded into a Vec before its length is validated. A token with arbitrarily many lowercase hex digits causes proportional allocation in from_hex, then fails in Signature::from_bytes. Check the exact 128-hex length first and decode directly into a fixed 64-byte array. Add a fixed-size bound before ArtifactSignature::decode parses CVNF wire bytes too.

[risk:high] Five answers. Failure modes: missing remote revocation becomes Active, and governance accepts unsigned real artifacts. Edge cases: empty or stale registries, compromised allowed keys, and synthetic tests without producers. Rollback: retain the primitive module, but revert delivered, satisfied, and PASS claims and do not wire it. Monitoring: alert on missing standing or freshness and require call-graph gates for every producer plus intent.accept. Validation: exercise actual receipt, bundle, and pack paths with unsigned, tampered, wrong-key, revoked, unknown-standing, and stale-revocation cases. Seal approval cannot replace a risk:critical human gate.

data.reason: High blockers: missing signer standing is accepted as Active, and TEST-9-07/T04 claim delivery without production signing or verification paths. Medium findings cover seed zeroization and unbounded signature parsing.

data.body: Fixed in 993e611. Verified now needs an authoritative registry entry: SignatureVerifier::new takes the authoritative RegistryHead (content identity of the audit log). A different head is StandingStale; a missing entry is StandingUnknown; neither is Active, and verify_for_ci_acceptance fails closed on both. Tests: a_signer_with_unknown_standing_is_unverified_not_active, a_stale_registry_missing_a_revocation_cannot_verify, an_empty_registry_verifies_no_signature.

Fixed in 993e611. TEST-9-07 is partial again; the docs/19 annotation is removed. The binding keeps the 21 library tests as evidence and checks the absence of production callers, naming bn-3glnv (wiring) and bn-1hape (producers, entropy). The T04 signing control is a typed gap again: signing-production-gap passes only while the library is present and no src/ outside continuum-evidence calls it. docs/09 T04 and ADR-0054 say the same; evidence regenerated after just traceability.

Fixed in 993e611. KeyEntropy::seed returns Zeroizing<[u8; 32]>; LocalSigner::from_seed takes it by value and drops it right after SigningKey::from_bytes, so the seed is wiped on success, weak-key and AlreadyMinted paths. zeroize =1.9.0 is a direct edge (default-features off); it was already in the lock with a bn-lf4i audit, so no package was added.

Fixed in 993e611. from_hex_exact checks exactly 128 hex digits before decoding into a fixed [u8; 64], with no allocation. ArtifactSignature::decode refuses more than MAX_SIGNATURE_RECORD_LEN (512) bytes with WireError::TooLarge before CVNF parsing. Tests: an_overlong_token_or_record_is_refused_before_decoding, a_signature_record_fits_the_decode_bound.

Addressed in 993e611: remote-revocation fail-open closed (StandingStale/StandingUnknown), delivered claims reverted to partial/typed gap with a checked production-caller absence, seed zeroized, parsing bounded. Rollback posture as suggested: primitive module kept.

[severity:medium] Re-review: fixed at crates/continuum-evidence/src/signing.rs:464-470 and :580-584. Token length is checked before fixed-array decoding, and encoded records over 512 bytes fail before Value::decode.

[severity:medium] Re-review: fixed at crates/continuum-evidence/src/signing.rs:608 and :637-640. The entropy seed is Zeroizing, moves into derivation, and drops before every return. SigningKey retains its separately zeroizing copy.

[severity:high] Re-review: fixed at crates/continuum-evidence/src/signing.rs:1375-1422. Registry-head mismatch returns StandingStale, missing standing returns StandingUnknown, and CI acceptance rejects both.

[severity:high] Re-review: fixed at notes/plan/docs/09_THREAT_MODEL.md:111, tools/governance/check_t04_evidence.py:751-783, and tools/test-policy/sections/s9_security_tests_07.py:44-46. Production signing remains a checked gap, and TEST-9-07 remains partial.

[risk:high] Re-review five answers. Failure modes: stale or unknown standing now fails closed, while production signing remains absent. Edge cases: empty registries, missing signers, stale pre-revocation registries, oversized records, and duplicate seeds are typed refusals. Rollback: remove the additive signing module and its two direct edges before any artifact carries this wire form. Monitoring: keep the production-caller absence gate, registry-head freshness checks, dependency placement checks, and partial TEST-9-07 state. Validation: the persisted range covers strict Ed25519 vectors, canonical envelopes, tampering, wrong keys, revocation, unknown and stale standing, bounded parsing, and CI fail-closed behavior. Seal LGTM does not replace the risk:critical human gate.
